fields.schemeName: Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide an opportunity for personnel from various government departments of the state to participate annually in the All-India level competitions in various sports, organized by the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for Minority Caste students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

fields.schemeName: Braille Equipment Provision
fields.briefDescription: The "Braille Equipment Provision" scheme aims to empower persons with visual disabilities to live independently by supporting their writing, computing, mobility, and entertainment needs. Through this scheme, Braille equipment is manufactured and made available to individuals and institutions.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The subsidy for 10-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimage travel for senior citizens of Gujarat by providing financial assistance for travel expenses. It benefits eligible senior citizens through reimbursements or direct arrangements with authorized travel agents.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides margin money subsidies (25–30%) for new rural industrial projects (₹1,00,000/- to 25,00,000/-) to artisans, entrepreneurs, and SHGs, leveraging a 24-hour electricity supply in villages. Beneficiaries must be aged 25–50 years with a Class 10th education.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY.

fields.schemeName: Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Haryana, aims to promote the use of solar energy for domestic water heating by providing a financial subsidy to the residents of Haryana and Haryana Government employees residing in Chandigarh.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 8 Ton/Day
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote fish feed self-sufficiency and affordability among fish farmers. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for setting up medium-sized fish feed mills with a production capacity of 8 tons per day, benefiting entrepreneurs and fish farmers.

fields.schemeName: Gaurav Puraskar Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Gaurav Puraskar Award" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to honour artistes for their significant achievements in music, dance, drama, and folk art by providing a cash award, trophy, and appreciation letter.

fields.schemeName: New Swarnima Yojana for Women (GTKVN)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote economic upliftment of women from Thakor & Koli communities living below poverty line by supporting them in self-employment ventures. Under this scheme, 100% financial support up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided to eligible women for starting a business/trade of their choice.

fields.schemeName: Micro Finance Scheme (GNDTDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme promotes self-employment among Nomadic and Denotified Tribes by offering loan up to ₹1,25,000 at a concessional interest rate to help start small-scale businesses or enterprises.

fields.schemeName: Swayam Saksham Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to instil a sense of self-reliance among youth pursuing vocational education/training. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing various professional units

fields.schemeName: Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create self-employment for women and make them self-reliant. Through this scheme, individual women entrepreneurs are provided with microfinance loans to start a business of their choice.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.

fields.schemeName: Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide self-employment loans to women from minority communities. Financial assistance with a 20% subsidy is provided to widows, divorced women, and abandoned women from minority communities. The scheme is implemented by the KSMDFC.

fields.schemeName: Mother Teresa Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the higher education of students belonging to minority communities. Through this scheme, an amount per annum is provided to students from minority religious communities domiciled in Kerala who are pursuing a diploma in nursing and paramedical courses from government.

fields.schemeName: CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students from minority religious communities studying Chartered Accounts/Cost & Management Accounts/Company Secretaryship courses. Through this scheme, a scholarship is provided to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage.Under this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided on insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insurance, helping them mitigate potential crop losses

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme: Haryana Women Development Corporation
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage female students from Haryana to pursue higher education and reduce their interest burden. Through this scheme, financial assistance and an interest subsidy are provided to eligible female students.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World" aims to promote mountaineering by providing financial aid to successful climbers, including up to ₹15,00,000 for those who scale Mt. Everest.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Economically Backward Class
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the education of poor students by offering scholarships from class 1st to 10th in government and aided schools.

fields.schemeName: Rock Climbing Adventure Training Course
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote physical fitness, adventure awareness, and confidence-building among children through a 6-day rock climbing adventure course for 100 children aged 9 to 12 years, organized at Mount Abu/ Junagadh Center.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Exhibitions Abroad and Out of State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote fine arts by providing financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 to artists from Gujarat for organizing art exhibitions abroad and in other states of India.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 1st Year Lease Money
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and to uplift these families by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Large RAS Culture System Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance for various inland fisheries activities, including the establishment of large Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), and is provided to individuals, societies, self-help groups, associations, reservoir leaseholders, and private entities.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Medium RAS Culture System Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance fish production and create employment through sustainable inland fisheries. It provides financial support to eligible beneficiaries for setting up medium-scale RAS units.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Back-Yard Mini RAS Unit Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance inland fish production and create employment. It provides subsidies to eligible beneficiaries for fish hatchery and RAS unit establishment.

fields.schemeName: Sub mission on Seeds and Planting Material
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase the production of certified/quality seed; strengthen Seed Testing Laboratories; assist Seed Producing Institutes for the adoption of new technologies, ensuring farmers get quality seeds at the right time and reasonable prices.

fields.schemeName: Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)" is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to promote growth in the horticulture sector through financial and technical support to farmers for cultivation, post-harvest management, and market linkage development.

fields.schemeName: Parivahan Scheme (GBCDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for vehicle purchases in the transport sector for SEBC unemployed individuals. A loan is provided under the scheme.

fields.schemeName: Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)" aims to encourage tribal farmers to bring their produce to market committees by providing financial assistance towards transportation costs.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture - Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase inland fish production and employment through reservoir-based fish farming. The scheme offers financial assistance to individuals and groups via the iKhedut portal.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Trible Area)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Tribal Area)" aims to enhance agricultural productivity by financially supporting co-operative irrigation societies in tribal areas through the installation of water distribution infrastructure.

fields.schemeName: Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls’ Hostel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage girls’ participation in education at the upper primary and secondary levels and to provide quality education to girls from disadvantaged groups (SC, ST, OBC, Minority communities and BPL families) studying in Classes 6 to 12.

fields.schemeName: Vocational Education Programme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to impart vocational education alongside academic learning to students of classes 9 to 12 in selected government secondary schools. Vocational education is offered in 08 sectors approved by the Government of India under the NSQF framework.

fields.schemeName: AGR-4 Scheduled Castes Sub-Plan for Distribution of Seeds and Fertilizers Input Kits at Subsidised Rates to Scheduled Caste Cultivators
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide subsidised seeds, fertilizers, and organic inputs to Scheduled Caste farmers to improve agricultural productivity.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: 100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help Adivasi farmers and tribal cultivators increase crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for various agricultural inputs and equipment such as seeds, fertilizers, plant protection equipment, and pump sets.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Plant protection pesticides Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help Scheduled Tribe farmers and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher agricultural crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this scheme, various tools and practices are provided to the farmers at subsidised rates.

fields.schemeName: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
fields.briefDescription: This certificate provides 5% horizontal reservation in Government/Non-Government services for affected children, including those whose both biological or adoptive parents have died within 21 years from the child’s birth. orphan children residing in voluntary or government-run homes within the state.

fields.schemeName: National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote organic farming practices through providing financial assistance for organic inputs and infrastructure support to farmers.

fields.schemeName: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Establishment of On farm Storage for Sorting-Grading
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Assistance for Establishment of On-Farm Storage for Sorting-Grading" aims to prevent post-harvest spoilage in horticultural crops by providing financial assistance for constructing storage infrastructure and purchasing sorting-grading equipment for farmers across the state.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed" aims to promote natural farming and hybrid seed cultivation through financial assistance to farmers. The scheme provides up to ₹20,000 per hectare to encourage sustainable agricultural practices.

fields.schemeName: Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among schools & students by providing cash awards to the best-performing schools at the high school & intermediate levels at the state level, as well as to students securing top positions in Uttarakhand Board High School & Intermediate Examinations.

fields.schemeName: Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad
fields.briefDescription: The scheme's purpose is to offer financial assistance to tribal students for higher education abroad. It provides a loan of up to ₹15,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate.
